overview: Host John Petrella interviewed 11-year-old Medford resident Liam Murphy to discuss his accomplishments in competitive swimming and his future athletic goals.

items.title: Guest Introduction and WBZ-TV Feature
items.summary: Host John Petrella introduced 11-year-old Medford swimmer Liam Murphy and played a WBZ-TV news feature highlighting his athletic achievements.

items.title: Swim Meet Achievements
items.summary: Liam Murphy detailed his success winning eight medals at the 2025 AAU Junior Olympics, six gold medals at the 2026 Bay State Games, and eight medals at the 2026 National Junior Olympics.

items.title: Athletic Background and Mystic Swimming
items.summary: Liam Murphy recalled starting his swimming training at Little Flippers in 2019 and later qualifying for the Mystic Swimming Club.

items.title: Favorite Events and Swimming Techniques
items.summary: Liam Murphy explained why the 100-meter backstroke is his favorite event and discussed the physical differences and endurance required for various swimming strokes.

items.title: Training Regimen and Mystic Swimming Structure
items.summary: Liam Murphy outlined his weekly in-water and dry land training, his current division in his swim club, and the commemorative rings he received for his Junior Olympic gold medals.

items.title: Race Preparation and Meet Dynamics
items.summary: Liam Murphy described his mental preparation, how mechanical starting blocks are used, and what it is like competing with his club teammates.

items.title: Family Support and Future Goals
items.summary: Liam Murphy recognized his parents' help with travel and officiating before sharing his goals to break high school records and swim in college.

items.title: Program Outro
items.summary: John Petrella thanked Liam Murphy and concluded the program with information on how viewers can access Medford Happenings online and on television.
